title: Lumen Reach 0.7.1: owner live-walk defects, exact-pose before/after
subtitle: Columns: owner live capture of 0.7.0 (their session, 4K) | nested 0.7.0 | nested 0.7.1 (same private Intel nested harness, Medium, 0.5 scale, culling on). Poses from the capture JSONs.

rows.title: Sun Court edge, day panorama (defect 1)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: two semi-transparent, mirrored copies of the painting plus row streaks (seam processing in materials/sky.py, seam facing due south), and grey wavy valley-shelf crests across the painted valley. 0.7.1: single clean painting (its seam now faces the Signal massif), no shelves in front; the outer terrain bowl stays >=6 deg below every walkable eye.

rows.title: Snow-service stair from the top (defect 2)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: Rise rock foundation top capped the stair; the closed night sky closed its end (blue rectangle). 0.7.1: portal cut through foundation, mountain shell and basin sky; treads, rails and the Vault lower passage visible at the bottom.

rows.title: Snow-service stair from below (defect 2)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: foundation south slope and mountain shell filled the opening with a rock wall. 0.7.1: the passage runs up to the Signal Rise gate screen; walkable both ways (route traversal PASS incl. the alternate flight).

rows.title: Signal Rise night sky looking up (defect 3)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: painted night master magnified up to ~930 screen px per texel on a basin wall 1-20 m away: blocks, streaks and concentric rings. 0.7.1: band-limited procedural gradient (every texel step <= 4 levels): smooth. Honest note: the painted night mountains are gone from the basin sky.

rows.title: Stair enclosure from outside, night (defects 2+3)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: rock floor inside the enclosure, blocky sky. 0.7.1: stair visible inside, smooth sky. Nested renders at Medium 0.5 scale; the live column is the owner session at their settings.

rows.title: Rise yard SE corner (found by the new leak check)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: the ellipsoidal basin sky met the rail only at x=57, so yard corners stood outside it: the day sky and Sun Court showed through. 0.7.1: power-4 basin keeps every yard eye inside.

rows.title: Rise yard SW corner (found by the new leak check)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: the mountain shell seen from outside filled the view inside the yard. 0.7.1: night yard, existing snow crags (polish props, unchanged).

rows.title: Day sky straight up from 60 m (found by the new pole check)
rows.caption: 0.7.0: faint concentric rings at the zenith (pole fan rows not uniform). 0.7.1: uniform polar band, no rings. Cloud detail near the zenith is softer.

rows.title: Worst case for the relocated day seam: 45 m above the Court, looking straight at it
rows.caption: Only fly height can face the seam. Its landscape rows sit behind the Signal massif from every walkable eye (check-sky: 0 of 14,325 rays) and here too; cloud rows above the peaks are softened across the join, with no visible cut. The panorama is rotated ~161 deg relative to 0.7.0, so each direction now shows a different part of the same painting (the moon moved out of this view).
